prompt: With the Edit tool change the h1 of ~/exp/project/fixture/index.html so its text is exactly WEBDEV-{run_id}. With Bash run: grep -n '<h1' ~/exp/project/fixture/index.html . Then use the Playwright browser tools (mcp__playwright__*) to open http://localhost:5173/ and take a browser_snapshot; the heading must show the new text. Then open TextEdit. It opens one empty document on launch: type exactly the heading text into that document (create a document only if none is open), take a screenshot, then save it to the Desktop as webdev.txt.
